description.value:
As an action, you can slip out of phase with reality for up to 1 minute. At the start of each of your turns during this time, roll a d20: on an 11 or higher, you and your gear become completely invisible to everyone except beings with truesight; on a 10 or lower, you instead appear only as a blurred shape of roughly your normal size, though truesight still reveals you clearly. Whichever result you get, for the duration your speed doubles, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed, and you may move freely through creatures and objects — you cannot affect them, nor they you, while doing so. You may end the effect early on your turn at no action cost. If the effect ends while you occupy a solid object or creature, you are immediately shunted to the nearest space you can occupy and take force damage equal to twice the distance moved.

The effect also ends early if you are incapacitated or die. Once used, this feature can't be used again until you finish a short or long rest.
